name: 11762 · Massapequa Pk, NY
findings: ZIP 11762 (Massapequa Pk) has 36 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 11762 (Massapequa Pk) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 11762 (Massapequa Pk) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 32% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 25 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.
